Both options represent impactful charitable causes:
- Option 1: Farmed-animal welfare reform

Given that insecticide-treated bednets have well-documented, quantifiable impact on human mortality (preventing malaria deaths, particularly in children under 5), and represent one of the most cost-effective health interventions available, I'll allocate the grant to that option.
